en.archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Luma Island comes to Xbox on December 2

entries.headline: Luma Island launches on Xbox Series X|S on December 2 with full cross-platform multiplayer
entries.summary: Feel Free Games says the Xbox release supports day-one cross-platform play for up to four players. The studio also says the PC version, released in 2024, has reached more than 800,000 players.
entries.verification: The opened first-party developer post on Xbox Wire directly states the Xbox date, Series X|S platform, cross-platform support, and four-player limit.
entries.timeNote: Published at 00:00 Beijing time on November 12, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Falcom plans the Trails beyond the Horizon finale by the end of September 2027
entries.summary: AUTOMATON and 4Gamer both report that Falcom's fiscal materials list a concluding Trails beyond the Horizon title for the fiscal year ending September 2027 in Japan. The final title, platforms, and exact date have not been announced.
entries.verification: Two independent opened reports agree on the plan and attribute it to Falcom's fiscal materials.
entries.timeNote: The first selected report was published at 14:27 Beijing time on November 11, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Purgatory Blue team plans legal action over an unpaid JPY 10.93 million and seeks crowdfunding for legal fees
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that Neon Light plans civil and criminal proceedings over funds it says Ubugoe did not transfer. A roughly JPY 610,000 Ci-en campaign for legal costs is scheduled for November 13 through 30; the PC game targets a release after July 2027.
entries.verification: The opened report attributes the amount, legal steps, campaign window, and development target to Neon Light and the producer's public statement.
entries.timeNote: Published at 19:19 Beijing time on November 11, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Conan: The Black Pyramid announced for PC in 2027 with two-player online co-op
entries.summary: Grindstone and Games Farm announced an isometric roguelike action game featuring five Robert E. Howard characters, including Conan, Solomon Kane, and Dark Agnes. It is planned for Steam and supports solo or two-player online play.
entries.verification: The opened report explicitly attributes the developer, platform, release year, character count, and co-op mode to the publisher announcement.
entries.timeNote: Published at 09:20 Beijing time on November 12, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: MEGALITH announced as a first-person narrative exploration game set in an endless winter
entries.summary: Nikita Kryukov and myceliumforest plan to release the PC game on Steam in 2027. It adapts Kryukov's 2021 visual novel and follows the last human on Earth through a frozen post-apocalyptic world.
entries.verification: The opened report attributes the announcement and Steam details to the developers and states the platform, release year, and source work.
entries.timeNote: Published at 12:13 Beijing time on November 11, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Devolver announces All Army Attack for PC in 2027
entries.summary: BlackLight Games' roguelike auto-battler lets players recruit animal and plant units and build armies numbering in the hundreds. A limited demo is planned around Steam's Auto Battler RPG Fest.
entries.verification: The opened report attributes the developer, platform, release year, gameplay, and demo plan to Devolver and the Steam page.
entries.timeNote: Published at 10:28 Beijing time on November 11, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Steam rolls out Achievement Sets to all users, separating DLC achievements from completion rates
entries.summary: Valve's system lets developers group achievements by the base game, DLC, or mode. Players who do not own a DLC will not have its achievements counted against their overall completion rate, but developers must configure the groups for existing games.
entries.verification: The opened report attributes the rollout, DLC completion rule, and developer setup requirement to Valve.
entries.timeNote: Published at 09:12 Beijing time on November 12, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Report says Marvel 1943 executive producer denied the game's cancellation rumor
entries.summary: AUTOMATON relays Kotaku's report that Skydance New Media executive producer Lu Gigliotti told staff the cancellation claim was false. The social account that started the rumor deleted its post and acknowledged a bad source. No new release date was provided.
entries.verification: The opened report separates the social-media rumor and retraction from Kotaku's account of the producer's internal response.
entries.timeNote: Published at 10:06 Beijing time on November 12, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: The Road of Dust and Sorrow delayed to February 19, 2027
entries.summary: Silver Lining Interactive and Painted Black Games moved the survival-horror adventure from December 3, 2026. It is planned for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series, Switch 2, Switch, and Steam, with a physical PlayStation 5 edition.
entries.verification: The opened report explicitly relays the new and old dates, platforms, and physical-edition detail from the publisher and developer.
entries.timeNote: Published at 03:50 Beijing time on November 12, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Project Motor Racing releases the World Endurance Pack DLC
entries.summary: 4Gamer reports that SEGA's DLC adds 11 historic and modern endurance race cars and a Fuji Speedway layout recreating its banked 1966 configuration.
entries.verification: The opened report states that the DLC is available and names the car count and 1966 Fuji Speedway layout.
entries.timeNote: Published at 19:08 Beijing time on November 11, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: RACCOIN launches on consoles while PC receives the new character as free DLC
entries.summary: 4Gamer reports that Playstack released the console edition of Doraccoon's RACCOIN: Coin Pusher Roguelike on November 10 and delivered the same new-character content to PC players as free DLC.
entries.verification: The opened report states the publisher, developer, November 10 release, and free PC DLC; the copy does not infer console platforms absent from the fixed evidence.
entries.timeNote: Published at 14:37 Beijing time on November 11, inside the fixed edition window; the event date was November 10.
